ticket.autoresp.title: Request received
ticket.autoresp.body:
COMMUNITY SUPPORT
TICKET %{ticket.number}

Request received

Your request has been received. A member of the %{ticket.dept.name} team will review it. Reply to this email if you need to add information.
Department: %{ticket.dept.name}
Subject: %{ticket.subject}
SLA: %{ticket.sla_summary}
Target deadline: %{ticket.due_date}
Service targets use calendar time. They are handling targets, not guaranteed resolution times. Your statutory rights remain unaffected.
View your ticket

Reply to this email to add information. Keep the ticket number in the subject. Do not email passwords or full identity documents.
